'''TK-0''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] who assisted and was taken care of by [[Gaib]].

==History==
He and Gaib worked together as a kind of high tech [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. They had been hired by [[Mereel Skirata]] to find [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]], who was trying to beat the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] cloning ban. He was similar in appearance to a [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]], except he was taller and better [[Armor/Legends|armored]].

When [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] son, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], was kidnapped during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] hired Gaib and TK-0 to find the location of his son. They successfully traced Rotta's location to [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]. Jabba was so impressed with the pair's work, he kept them on retainer.
